data_fields.name: quest_kill_credit_count
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per creature (first player in looting order with the quest)

best_idea: Keep a per-player done list with a restart time per quest type (zero, a fixed cooldown, or never), write it at the end of a quest, and drop an expired entry the next time the offer is checked, so cooldowns need no timer.
decision_why: The restart gate is cheap and fits zone-as-data quest pacing, but the donor's kill credit and dialogue state are not server-verified, so Frankendom keeps the checks and the state on the server and writes the restart store into the one ledger.
acceptance: A server test where a 5-minute quest completed at T is refused at T+4:59 and offered at T+5:01, a cancelled never-quest is not offered again, and a creature with three attackers credits the quest to exactly one of them.
